results.title: TB Network Decries Shortages Of ACTs/ITNs In Zamfara PHCs
results.description: The Tuberculosis (TB) network team has embarked on an advocacy tour with a view to addressing reported gaps in the availability of essential malaria commodities, particularly artemisinin-based combination therapies (ACTs) and insecticide-treated nets (ITNs) for pregnant women and children in selected primary healthcare facilities across Zamfara State.
